name: com.smcad.tankrig
description: [Alpha / experimental] Companion to SMC-AD: turns a tank model imported with SMC-AD into a drivable tank. A builder window to pick hull / turret / gun mount / barrel, place mirrored tracks and effect points with the mouse, and rig it in one click. Hull-only Rigidbody physics with torsion-bar suspension, rendered tracks that follow the terrain, War Thunder style WASD + mouse controls, gun recoil, muzzle / machine gun / exhaust effects and lights (HDRP only: particle Shader Graph, lights in physical units). Comes with 6- and 7-wheel running gear and five track link designs.
